primary_source_receipts.locator: Ramsey Solutions, The National Study of Millionaires research page
primary_source_receipts.finding: Survey of over 10,000 U.S. millionaires: 79% received no inheritance; three in four credit regular, consistent long-term investing.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Self-reported survey by a company that sells financial advice; page date approximate.

primary_source_receipts.locator: DALBAR QAIB press coverage (30th annual report and earlier editions)
primary_source_receipts.finding: Summaries report average equity investor returns well below the S&P 500 over 20- and 30-year windows; the specific 10.65%/7.13% pair for 1992-2021 was not found.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Summaries only; the full QAIB reports were not read.

primary_source_receipts.locator: Devenir 2025 Year-End HSA Research Report release
primary_source_receipts.finding: About 4.2 million accounts, about 10% of all HSAs, held invested dollars at year-end 2025; investment assets about $85B of $174B.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Release date approximate (early 2026); may post-date the 25 March 2026 upload by days; earlier Devenir reports also showed about 9-10%.

primary_source_receipts.locator: Reports of the IRS notice to participating states, November 2025
primary_source_receipts.finding: "IRS Direct File will not be available in Filing Season 2026." Free File remained, with an $84,000 AGI limit in the 2025 season.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Secondary reporting of an IRS email; the IRS page reads "Direct File is closed".
